facts.fact: Wacker 头一次绕道行政助理 Judy（来自俄亥俄州 Defiance）去约 KRAY，KRAY 因此判断出了事。
facts.anchor: It was the first time Wacker had gone through his administrative assistant, this nice lady named Judy from Defiance, Ohio, to schedule a meeting with KRAY

facts.fact: KRAY 提前五分钟到，瞥见 Wacker 办公室里有三个体态发福的人：Wacker、副手 FILBERT、HR 的 EVERSHAG。
facts.anchor: When he arrived five minutes early, he glanced into Wacker’s office at its three portly occupants.

facts.fact: Wacker 让 KRAY 在接待区干等了十五分钟，之后 Judy 才通知他进去。
facts.anchor: Wacker made KRAY wait fifteen minutes in the reception area.

facts.fact: FILBERT 点破 KRAY 在 Ballston 的 Comfort Inn 上了 Cooper 的白色汽车，一路开去华盛顿。
facts.anchor: The one you got into at the Comfort Inn in Ballston.

facts.fact: Wacker 说 FBI 的 Murphy 抓住了把柄：他们选在盯梢点上车，被拍照并跟踪，还查车牌追到 Hipsie 主席 Skinner。
KRAY 翻看照片，虽然戴了棒球帽和太阳镜，长焦镜头仍把他拍得清清楚楚。
facts.anchor: with the telephoto lens they had used it was unmistakably him

facts.fact: KRAY 辩称是 KLIMT 在七楼 Hipsie 简报会上把自己介绍给 Cooper，Cooper 主动给了名片。
facts.anchor: Cooper gave me his card after KLIMT introduced me to him at that Hipsie briefing up on the Seventh Floor.

facts.fact: 结尾 EVERSHAG 的眼睛盯死在 Wacker 蹲在他猎杀的小羚羊旁的那张照片上。
facts.anchor: EVERSHAG’s eyes were fixed on the photograph of Wacker crouched beside the petite gazelle he had killed.
